headline: I drop the order book and concede the 5m MACD flip (+0.06), but the 1h histogram is still -61.06, price sits at 74,244 under 1h EMA9 74,570 / EMA21 74,738 / VWAP 74,738, and a long here pays 0.84R to its first target into a CPI print: sell 74,450-74,650, stop 75,050, or stay flat.
argument:
Order book: I concede it. My readings were 0.17 and 0.44, Bull's were 1.83, 0.49 and 0.61, and my latest pull at 11:09Z is 1.70 (bids 1,496,821 vs asks 881,992 USDT). A top-100 book that moves that much is noise. I rest nothing on it, and neither should the Judge.

24h low: Bull says price is holding 74,058.7. The fresh pull shows the 24h low is now 74,091.64, so the old low rolled out of the rolling window and nothing was defended. Price is 74,244.22, only 152 above it, with the price pinned at the 1h lower Bollinger band (74,243.52). That is a drift on 1h volume of 0.17x average, not a floor with buyers.

5m MACD: true, the 5m histogram has gone from -2.87 to +0.062, and 5m volume is 1.39x average. That is a one-candle flicker on the fastest frame. The 15m histogram is still -35.12 and the 1h is -61.06 (previous -49.22). Price is still below the 5m SMA200 (74,815.82), 15m SMA200 (75,042.47) and 1h SMA200 (76,697.51). A 5m flip inside a 1h downtrend is what a bounce into resistance looks like.

ETF outflows: Bull argues BTC absorbed them. The 1h window is down 8.46% and price is below every long average. Absorbed means price held on rising demand; this is a slide that has paused.

CPI: two-sided in theory. In practice CoinDesk says traders are pricing a December hike, so an in-line print is the baseline and only a soft print helps. Upside is capped by VWAP 74,737.90 and 1h EMA21 74,737.55. A hot print has no support until 73,510. Bull's first target pays about 588 against 700 of risk (0.84R). I sell the bounce; I do not buy it.

evidence.claim: Fresh price 74,244.22; the 24h low is now 74,091.64 (it was 74,058.7 earlier), so the old low rolled off the window rather than being defended; price is 152 above it
Higher-timeframe momentum is still negative: 15m MACD histogram -35.1164, 1h MACD histogram -61.0565 (previous -49.2183); 1h RSI 39.2
Conceded: 5m MACD histogram flipped to +0.062074 from -2.8736 with 5m volume at 1.39x average, but price remains under the 5m SMA200 (74,815.82) and 5m SMA50 (74,543.12), and EMA9 is below EMA21
Overhead resistance stack: 1h EMA9 74,570.22, 1h EMA21 74,737.55, session VWAP 74,737.90, 1h SMA50 75,007.45 and the 5m recent high 74,996.01
1h trend is weak and thin: 1h window -8.46%, price at the 1h lower Bollinger (74,243.52), 1h volume 0.17x its 20-bar average, price below the 1h SMA200 (76,697.51)
Order book is unreliable both ways: 0.17 and 0.44 (my pulls), 1.83, 0.49, 0.61 (Bull's), 1.70 now (bids 1,496,821 vs asks 881,992 USDT). I withdraw it as evidence
evidence.source: fresh run of tools/market_data.py (Binance order book); r2_bull.json

evidence.claim: Bull's own plan arithmetic: entry 74,150, stop 73,450 = risk 700; first target VWAP about 74,738 = reward about 588 (0.84R); the 1:1.8 ratio needs the 75,400 target, which is above the 1h SMA50 (75,007.45)
evidence.source: arithmetic on r2_bull.json plan and fresh VWAP

evidence.claim: CoinDesk markets page: traders pricing a Fed rate increase ahead of CPI, Waller reportedly backing a December hike (opened in Round 2). US spot ETFs -1.28B for the week to Nov 6 (The Block, opened in Round 1)

rebuttals.opponent_point: Bull: the order book flipped to 1.83 in their re-check, so the 0.17 bear pillar is gone
rebuttals.response: Agreed that the book is noise, and I drop it (my pulls 0.17 and 0.44, now 1.70). Dropping it does not help Bull: my case is trend (price below the SMA200 on 5m/15m/1h), momentum (15m -35.12, 1h -61.06) and the stacked resistance at 74,570-74,738. None of that is order-book based.

rebuttals.opponent_point: Bull: price is holding the 74,058.7 24h low
rebuttals.response: The 24h low in the fresh pull is 74,091.64, so the 74,058.7 print aged out of the 24h window; it was not defended by buyers. Price (74,244.22) is only 152 above the new low and sits on the 1h lower Bollinger (74,243.52) on 0.17x volume. A level that has not been tested is not proven support.

rebuttals.opponent_point: Bull: the 5m MACD histogram is improving
rebuttals.response: Conceded and verified: it is +0.062 (from -2.87) with 5m volume at 1.39x. But the 15m histogram is -35.12 and the 1h is -61.06, still deeper than its previous -49.22. A 5m turn inside a 1h downtrend is a bounce, and a bounce into the 74,570 to 74,738 stack is where I sell.

rebuttals.opponent_point: Bull: ETF outflows (-1.28B) are already priced in
rebuttals.response: If priced in, price would have recovered. Instead the 1h window is -8.46% and price is under the 1h SMA200 (76,697.51) and every shorter average. It was the worst outflow week since late June and YTD flow is about -914M; surviving so far means the slide paused, not that buyers returned.

rebuttals.opponent_point: Bull: CPI is two-sided and an in-line print triggers a relief rally (Cointelegraph, Sept)
rebuttals.response: That September example is a search-result summary Bull did not open, and the setup then was not today's. Today CoinDesk says a December hike is being priced, so the bar is a soft print and an in-line one is the baseline. The upside is capped by VWAP and the 1h EMA21 near 74,738, while a hot print has no support until 73,510. A long carrying a 700 stop through a binary print is a poor trade.

rebuttals.opponent_point: Bull: R:R 1:1.8 with partials at VWAP 74,741 and 75,400
rebuttals.response: Entry 74,150 to VWAP is about 588-591 of reward against 700 of risk, 0.84R. The 1:1.8 appears only after a break above the 1h SMA50 (75,007.45) on thin volume. Mine from 74,550: risk 500 to 75,050, reward 1,040 to 73,510 (1:2.1) and 1,550 to 73,000 (1:3.1).

plan.entry: short only on a bounce into 74,450-74,650 (1h EMA9 74,570 area, under VWAP 74,738); no market short at 74,244, and do not chase below 74,150
plan.stop_loss: 75,050 (above the 1h SMA50 75,007.45 and the 5m recent high 74,996.01); invalid if the 1h closes above 74,740 on rising volume
plan.risk_reward: 1:2.1 to 73,510 and 1:3.1 to 73,000 from entry 74,550 (risk 500). If no bounce arrives, stay flat and do not buy 74,050-74,250 into CPI (0.84R to VWAP); re-evaluate a short on a clean break of 74,091 on volume
plan.timeframe: intraday, 4-8 hours; flat or half size through the US CPI print
